policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O releases GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: O published safety overview material for GPT-6 Astra and highlights robust performance against prompt injection and misaligned actions, plus ongoing investigation of monitorability findings.

items.headline: O limits Astra cyber access
items.summary: O said Astra’s most powerful cybersecurity capabilities will launch to a small set of trusted testers first, indicating staged rollout tied to its “critical” safety threshold.

items.headline: G closes $350M Series A
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A, valuing the company at $3.5B, and said it will scale from 54MW to 200+MW in 2027 to expand inference capacity.
